description: Maharashtra has earmarked ₹15 crore for a four-year project that will use AI, drone imaging and archaeological research to analyse thousands of prehistoric petroglyphs across 107 Konkan villages, bolstering efforts to secure UNESCO World Heritage status for the sites.
body_lead: The Maharashtra government is making technology meet archaeology by using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to scientifically analyse, classify and interpret the origin and cultural etymology of thousands of prehistoric petroglyphs scattered across the Konkan region, a move that could significantly strengthen India’s bid to secure UNESCO World Heritage status for these ancient sites. The state government has allocated Rs 15 crore for this project, which is estimated to take four years.
